list.title: Images
list.intro: Illustrations of the characters, with their Zoom Out sequence. Importing never approves anything: every image starts unverified.

import.title: Import
import.searchHint: Type a name, then pick the character below.
import.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Several files can be imported at once. Imported pictures start unverified.
import.pick: Choose a character first: imported pictures belong to the selected character.

review.SEQUENCE_REQUIRED: Save a sequence first: an approval covers its frames.
review.title: Review
review.intro: The approval covers the saved frames. Changing the frames of an approved image withdraws its approval.
review.saveFirst: Save the sequence before reviewing it.
review.sensitiveIntro: An approval for sensitive modes is an explicit decision about these frames. The server checks again that the character, the universe and the modes allow it.
review.noteHint: At least {{count}} characters: what was checked, and why these frames are appropriate.
review.confirmSensitive: I have reviewed every frame of this sequence and they are appropriate for sensitive modes.

delete.confirm: Delete the image, its sequence and its files for good?

canvas.focus: Focus point, {{x}}% across and {{y}}% down. Use the arrow keys to move it.
canvas.frameHelp: Arrow keys move the frame, plus and minus change its zoom. Highest zoom for this picture: ×{{max}}.

simple.title: Generate the sequence
simple.focusHint: Click the picture to place the focus point: the center of the first frames. Drag the cross or use the fields below to fine-tune it.
simple.zoomStartHint: First frame: tight, on a detail.
simple.zoomEndHint: Last frame: ×1 is the whole picture.
simple.preserve: Keep the steps I adjusted by hand
simple.staleRatio: The frames were made for another ratio. Generate again to apply the new one.

advanced.title: Generate the sequence
advanced.noSteps: Generate a sequence first, then adjust its steps here.
advanced.stepNameHint: Optional. Left empty, the step is called “Step N”.
advanced.frameHint: Drag the frame on the picture, or use the fields. Editing a frame marks the step as adjusted by hand.

preview.title: Preview
preview.region: Preview of the steps. Left and right arrows change step.
preview.empty: Generate a sequence to preview it here, at the display ratio of the game.

problems.INVALID_IMAGE_SIZE: The picture has no usable size.
problems.INVALID_RATIO: The display ratio is not valid.
problems.INVALID_STEP_COUNT: Choose a whole number of steps between 1 and {{max}}.
problems.INVALID_FOCUS: Place the focus point inside the picture.
problems.INVALID_ZOOM: The zoom must be a positive number.
problems.INVALID_RECT: A frame is outside the picture.
problems.START_NOT_TIGHTER: The initial zoom must be tighter (higher) than the final zoom.

warnings.ZOOM_RAISED_TO_FIT: A zoom below ×1 was raised to ×1, the widest frame this ratio allows (step {{steps}}).
warnings.ZOOM_LIMITED: A zoom was lowered to the highest this picture allows, so that frames stay readable (step {{steps}}).
warnings.RECT_ADJUSTED_TO_RATIO: A frame did not have the display ratio: it was adjusted around its center (step {{steps}}).
warnings.FRAME_SHIFTED_INSIDE_IMAGE: Some frames were shifted to stay inside the picture, for instance a frame almost as large as the picture, or one near an edge (steps {{steps}}).
warnings.MANUAL_DROPPED_one: {{count}} step adjusted by hand did not fit in the new length and was dropped.
warnings.MANUAL_DROPPED_other: {{count}} steps adjusted by hand did not fit in the new length and were dropped.

save.withdrawsApproval: This image is approved. Saving changed frames withdraws the approval, and it will have to be reviewed again.

random.title: Random draw
random.hint: A focus point is drawn automatically, then the sequence is generated for it. Relaunch to draw again, preview the result, and switch to Advanced mode to adjust the steps.
random.zoomEndHint: Last frame: ×1 by default, the whole picture.
random.zoneHint: The focus is drawn in the central {{zone}}% of the picture, away from the borders.
random.fixed: Once saved, the draw stays fixed: nothing is ever drawn again during games.
random.replacesManual: Relaunching replaces every step, including the ones you adjusted by hand.
